title: 第3章 还请族长替我们做主第4章 胆敢擅闯我姜家者一个不留
slug: 投资天命族人我实力是全族总和

闻言，在场所有人都下意识扭头，循声望去。此刻，只见门口处。赫然站着一位身姿雄伟，面如冠玉，剑眉星目的白衣男子。他负手而立，黑发随意披散在肩膀上，一袭白袍因沾染血迹，隐约间透露无尽肃杀之意！待看清男子面容，众多姜家族人的瞳孔剧缩，一脸不敢置信。他们认出了来人的身份。正是他们日思夜久矣的姜家族长……姜道玄！！“是族长！族长出关了！我曾在六年前有幸见过他一面，绝对错不了！”“族长实力滔天，如今，我等绝境破矣！”“还请族长替我们做主啊！这唐家正欲断我姜家数百年传承，简直欺人太甚！”眼看姜道玄出现，所有姜家子弟就好像找到了主心骨，原本跌落谷底的心，也随之升腾起来！在他们之中，不少人都是听着姜道玄故事长大的。那可是曾经凭借一己之力，便压得邬旦城所有先天都抬不起头的霸主！甚至，姜家能够在邬旦城中占据一席之地，与唐、孙、高三家共同位列四大家族，姜道玄功不可没。这时，听着姜家族人的欢呼雀跃之声。原本还有些不明所以的唐家族人也都纷纷反应过来，旋即陷入惊骇。“姜道玄？这怎么可能！不是说他都已经闭关六年之久了吗？怎么现在还活着？！”“这可该如何是好？姜道玄可是连我们老祖都要忌惮三分的人，我们真能够应付吗？”“要要不我们还是撤退吧？我们有老祖坐镇，又没真覆灭他姜家，最多赔偿一些资源便是。”众多唐家族人未战先怯，一脸惶恐。同为四大家族之人。他们自然对姜道玄的赫赫威名不感到陌生。那可是曾被邬旦城当今城主誉为，最有希望成为城中第三位紫府境的顶尖天才！如今，这等存在降临，就好似一座无法翻越的巍峨大山，实在令人望而却步，心生绝望！所以，现在完全不是能否覆灭姜家的问题了，而是他们能否全身而退的问题。唐家族人尚且震惊。原本身为姜家供奉的王氏三兄弟，更是惊骇欲绝。“族长？”他们无法相信自己的眼睛。明明已经闭关六年，被大家默认为死亡的姜道玄，居然还会再次出现。忽然，他们内心涌生悔意。要是早知道姜道玄会出现，他们又何必当着众人面改换门庭？当真搞得自己里外不是人。不过，念及我们为家族效力这么多年的份上，族长应该不会对我们怎么样吧？“姜道玄？”唐正阳睁大双眼，俨然一副见了鬼的表情。他怎么也没料到，刚才出声之人，竟然是那早已被当作死人的姜道玄！面对这位威震邬旦城的人物，即便他已经晋升先天境圆满，内心却仍旧感到惊慌失措。姜家人群中。大长老看向姜道玄。他嘴唇微张，内心纵然有着千言万语，却不知从何开始。只因一切都太过梦幻，令他无比担心这只是自己的幻想而已！“无需担忧，好好休息，接下来，就交给我。”姜道玄看向大长老，轻声道。话音落下，如春风拂过，沐浴人心，令姜家众人神情一松，内心郁结消散，浑身清爽。随后，姜道玄转头看向唐正阳。四目相对。冰冷的眸光便令唐正阳身躯一颤。额头不断冒着粗汗，只感觉嗓子发干，下意识咽了口水。在此等威势之下，他立即萌生退意。“姜姜族长，这一切其实都是个误会，您听我解释”事到如今，什么吞并姜家的计划，早已抛之脑后，活命才是最重要的。“解释？”姜道玄面色冷峻。抬手之间，一道元力迸发而出，以迅雷不及掩耳之势，洞穿了唐正阳的身躯，将其炸成一团血雾！淅淅淅血液如雨水落下，将四周墙壁染得通红，更于地面形成一片血泊！画面骇人至极，触目惊心。将所有唐家族人吓得色如死灰，魂飞天外！自家族长竟然被姜道玄随手一击轰杀了？没有人能够料到这个结局。即便是在场的姜家族人也都齐齐愣住。旋即用看怪物一般的眼神，看向姜道玄。要知道唐正阳可是货真价实的先天境圆满高手，怎么可能会如同鸡仔一般，被族长随手宰了？难道族长大人突破紫府境了？一想到这个可能，众人便激动得浑身发抖。在姜家众人崇拜的目光下。姜道玄面色冷漠，轻描淡写地抽回手。“你的死，便是对本族长最好的解释。”话音一落，便令唐家众人内心为之一颤，顿时噤若寒蝉，就连大气都不敢喘！

Hearing this, everyone present subconsciously turned their heads and followed the sound. At this moment, all I can see is the doorway. Standing impressively was a man in white with a majestic figure, a face like a crown of jade, sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes. He stood with his hands behind his hands, his black hair hanging casually on his shoulders, and his white robe was stained with blood, vaguely revealing the meaning of endless chilling! When they saw the man's face clearly, the pupils of many Jiang family members shrank sharply, with expressions of disbelief on their faces. They recognized the person's identity. It was the head of the Jiang family that they had been thinking about day and night... Jiang Daoxuan! ! "It's the patriarch! The patriarch is out of seclusion! I was lucky enough to meet him six years ago. I can't be wrong!" "The patriarch is so powerful. Now, we are in dire straits!" "Please ask the patriarch to make the decision for us! The Tang family is trying to cut off the hundreds of years of inheritance of my Jiang family. It is simply too deceptive!" Seeing Jiang Daoxuan appear, all the children of the Jiang family seemed to have found their backbone, and their hearts that had fallen to the bottom began to rise! Among them, many people grew up listening to Jiang Daoxuan's stories. That was the overlord who once relied on his own power to overwhelm all the people in Wudan City who couldn't lift their heads! In fact, the Jiang family can occupy a place in Wudan City and rank among the four major families together with the Tang, Sun, and Gao families, and Jiang Daoxuan's contribution is indispensable. At this time, the Jiang family members were heard cheering. The Tang family members, who were still a little confused at first, all reacted and immediately fell into horror. "Jiang Daoxuan? How is this possible! Didn't you say that he has been in seclusion for six years? Why is he still alive now?!" "What should we do? Jiang Daoxuan is a person that even our ancestors are afraid of. Can we really handle it?" "How about we retreat? We have our ancestors in charge, and we have not really destroyed the Jiang family. The most we can do is compensate for some resources." Many Tang family members were timid before fighting, with a look of fear on their faces. They are members of the four major families. Naturally, they are no strangers to Jiang Daoxuan's prestigious reputation. That was once praised by the current city lord of Wudan City as the top genius who has the best chance of becoming the third Zifu Realm in the city! Nowadays, the arrival of such existence is like a towering mountain that cannot be climbed. It is really daunting and despairing! Therefore, now it is not a question of whether the Jiang family can be destroyed, but whether they can escape intact. The Tang family members were still shocked. The three Wang brothers, who were originally worshippers of the Jiang family, were even more horrified. "Clan leader?" They couldn't believe their eyes. Jiang Daoxuan, who had been in seclusion for six years and was considered dead by everyone, actually appeared again. Suddenly, they felt regret. If they had known that Jiang Daoxuan would appear, why would they have changed the door in front of everyone? I really made myself look like a human being inside and out. However, considering that we have served the family for so many years, the patriarch shouldn't do anything to us, right? "Jiang Daoxuan?" Tang Zhengyang opened his eyes wide, as if he had seen a ghost. He never expected that the person who spoke just now was Jiang Daoxuan, who had long been regarded as dead! Facing this powerful figure in Wudan City, even though he had reached the Perfect Innate Realm, he still felt panicked in his heart. Among the Jiang family. The great elder looked at Jiang Daoxuan. His lips were slightly open, and even though he had thousands of words in his heart, he didn't know where to start. Just because everything was too dreamy, he was extremely worried that it was just his fantasy! "No need to worry, have a good rest, and leave the next step to me." Jiang Daoxuan looked at the great elder and said softly. The words fell, like the spring breeze blowing, bathing people's hearts, making everyone in the Jiang family feel relaxed, their inner depression dissipated, and their bodies felt refreshed. Then, Jiang Daoxuan turned to look at Tang Zhengyang. Eyes facing each other. The cold eyes made Tang Zhengyang tremble. Sweat continued to break out on his forehead, his throat felt dry, and he swallowed subconsciously. Under such power, he immediately wanted to retreat. "Chief Jiang Jiang, all this is actually a misunderstanding. Please listen to my explanation." Now that things have happened, what is annexation?The Jiang family's plans have long been forgotten, and survival is the most important thing. "Explanation?" Jiang Daoxuan looked grim. As he raised his hand, a burst of Yuan Power burst out, piercing through Tang Zhengyang's body with lightning speed and blasting him into a ball of blood mist! Blood dripped down like rain, dyeing the surrounding walls red and forming a pool of blood on the ground! The picture is extremely horrifying and shocking. All the Tang family members were so frightened that they turned pale and their souls flew into the sky! The head of the family was killed by Jiang Daoxuan with a casual blow? No one could have predicted this outcome. Even the Jiang family members present were all stunned. Immediately, he looked at Jiang Daoxuan with eyes that looked like a monster. You must know that Tang Zhengyang is a genuine master of the Xiantian Realm. How could he be like a chicken and be slaughtered by the clan leader? Could it be that the patriarch has broken through to the Zifu realm? At the thought of this possibility, everyone was trembling with excitement. Under the admiring eyes of everyone in the Jiang family. Jiang Daoxuan looked cold and withdrew his hand lightly. "Your death is the best explanation for the leader of this clan." As soon as the words fell, everyone in the Tang family trembled in their hearts, and they suddenly fell into silence, not even daring to breathe!
